description.value: A McDonald's fast-food restaurant on Scott Road in the Tsawwassen/Delta area, offering burgers, chicken sandwiches, McCafé coffee drinks, and a drive-through. It is a convenient stop for touring cyclists needing a quick, familiar meal along this corridor. The MyMcDonald's Rewards app provides loyalty points on purchases.
